title: CAR T-Cell Therapy's Autoimmune Pivot
caption: The biggest cancer breakthrough in decades isn't just for tumors anymore. CAR T-cell therapy, once exclusive to oncology, now shows radical promise against chronic autoimmune diseases. See how this biotech pivot changes everything for millions. BUILD for the field guide.

slides.headline: The Cancer Therapy That's About To Cure *Autoimmune Disease*
slides.sub: CAR T-cells are rewriting the rulebook for chronic illness.

slides.definition: A personalized immunotherapy using genetically engineered T-cells to target and destroy specific cells. Originally for blood cancers, now repurposed for chronic autoimmune conditions.
slides.example: Patients with lupus and rheumatoid arthritis are seeing complete remission.

slides.title: TARGETING THE SOURCE
slides.body: Instead of attacking cancer cells, CAR T-cells are re-engineered to eliminate B-cells responsible for producing autoantibodies. This resets the immune system, stopping the disease at its root.

slides.title: UNEXPECTED REMISSIONS
slides.footer: Trial data shows complete, drug-free remission in severe cases.

slides.title: MILLIONS AFFECTED
slides.footer: A new paradigm shifts treatment from symptom management to cure.

slides.title: OBSTACLES AHEAD
slides.body: CAR T-cell therapy is complex, expensive, and carries significant risks including cytokine release syndrome. Scaling production and reducing costs are critical for wider adoption.

slides.hook: This isn't just a treatment. It's a *rethink*.
slides.sub: Stay ahead of the next wave in biotech and AI.
